I want to lock a standby facilitator (Vivek) in case Vanessa is pulled into back-to-back customer ops. I've attached the demo runbook (runbook_v2.pdf) and the customer-facing deck we intend to present (deck-cloudnova-demo.pptx).

Also cc'ing our AWS partner contact if they want to join — a short 15-minute pre-call the day before is often helpful.

Next steps: please reply with preferred window + who you'll have on the call (AE/SE/SI). If you confirm, I'll send calendar invites and a 15-min pre-call for the day before.

Thanks,
